# Recall People

> Recall People is a voice-first personal CRM for iOS and Android. Record a quick voice note after any conversation — AI automatically extracts names, facts, and upcoming events into smart contact profiles. All data is stored locally on your device for complete privacy.

## What it does

Recall People helps you remember everyone you meet. After a conversation, you record a voice note describing what you learned. The app transcribes your voice, extracts structured information (names, facts, dates, topics), and builds a searchable contact profile. It also schedules reminders for upcoming events mentioned in conversations and generates AI-powered conversation starters for your next meeting.

## Key features

- Voice-first capture: record notes in English, French, Spanish, Italian, or Portuguese
- AI extraction: automatically identifies names, facts, dates, and events from voice notes
- Smart contact profiles: all information about a person in one place
- Event reminders: never miss a birthday, meeting, or follow-up
- Semantic search: ask questions like "Who works in tech?" or "Who has kids?"
- AI conversation starters: get personalized ice breakers before your next meeting
- Privacy-first: all data stored locally on your device using SQLite, never on our servers
- Offline access: browse contacts and notes without internet
- Data export: JSON and CSV export anytime

## Who it's for

- Professionals who attend networking events, conferences, and meetings
- Consultants and freelancers managing many client relationships
- Anyone who wants to be more thoughtful in their personal relationships
- People who forget names and conversation details

## How it's different from other CRMs

- Voice-first input (no manual data entry or typing)
- Built for personal relationships, not sales pipelines
- Privacy-focused: local storage on device, no cloud database
- AI handles all the organization automatically

## Pricing

- Free: 10 voice notes, 10 AI questions, unlimited AI avatars
- Pro ($5.99/month or $35.99/year): unlimited everything + priority support
